# `browser-tab select`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab select <--selector <json>> [--projection [p]]`

Resolve a control-language selector against the live snapshot (needs daemon)

## Flags

### `--selector <json>`

Selector AST as JSON; @<file> reads a file, - reads stdin

### `--projection [p]`

Result shape

**Choices:**

- `core`
- `ids`
- `count`
